scope: Unit-thickness free-face flat puncture; broad R=1,2 held-waist annular specimens in four spatial dimensions. All results are small-strain crystal forces in model units.
material: mu=K=chi in curved specimens, with chi frozen at the saved J=1 preparation. The flat test permits arbitrary nonnegative depth-dependent mu and has zero trace.
geometry: Flat test uses the entire infinite H=1 slab outside a round through-hole. Curved test selects the outer radial half of the archived ordered duct, using b/2 <= r <= b. Both radial faces and both ends are registered. Sideways angular cross sections have measure 4*pi*r^2. The actual crystalline support depth is unknown.
placement: In the flat test d is natural minus current aperture radius. In the annulus d multiplies the infinitesimal compatible reference shift A*f(t)/r^2 with A=(0.25)^2, f=16*t^2*(1-t)^2, axial reference shift zero. The finite generating map is rho^3=r^3+3*d*A*f(t); it preserves volume and matches the identity in value and slope at both joins. Linear elasticity uses only its tangent. Natural-map alternatives can join the same flat far preparation. Interior displacements reequilibrate; calibrated force components conjugate to radial widening x*4*t*(1-t) and physical lengthening at fixed t.
exclusion: No archived inward total, trapped-wave or order-interface force is added. The occupied scalar-order state labels the same background for the conditional material measurements. A self-consistent new equilibrium, wave re-solve, physical rim preparation and free fall require additional data.
reproduction: Run from the project root through the guard using the included launch command. Each named shape and order snapshot is verified against its original committed measurement.

joined.scope: Linear crystal virtual work on b/2 <= r <= 1.5b. Retains the occupied interior order and freshly reads nodal order from the existing neutral exterior solver. At both grids its energy is checked against the held central two-sided archive. Independently interpolates each original order chart onto its own crystal half. Both elastic moduli equal chi.
joined.constraints: Perfect registration across b is an explicit hypothesis. The two meridional displacement components are continuous and force-free on the shared internal trace apart from its corners. Only the two ends and outer radial cuts have prescribed motion. The extent, attachments, natural placement, frozen scalar-order field, and chosen lattice bulk modulus are conditional. The material marker at the free internal join moves relative to the archived dividing surface, so cut-widening force is conjugate to cut displacement. To first order the same Eulerian background labels the two opposite rest registrations.
joined.accounting: Both-sided volume stress and elastic storage are reported separately. Signed opening and lengthening boundary work uses disjoint outer/inner cuts and ends, assigning all four corners to the ends. Internal join reactions cancel. Free-face flat through-hole control and one-sided control are in the main reading. No carrier, unavailable receiving-side wave or order surface energy was added.
